content: The third vector, inconsistency-vector INLINEFORM0 , represents the inconsistency between the system's response and INLINEFORM1 . Every time a slot is mentioned by the system, when describing a venue (inform) or confirming a slot-value pair (expl-conf or impl-conf), the indices corresponding to the slots that have been misunderstood are set to 1. The length of INLINEFORM2 is the number of informable slots. This vector is necessary in order for the NUS to correct the system.
